verdict.rationale: Anrok's materials say certificates are "collected, verified, and stored" and can be uploaded through the UI or the API, including for customers before their first billing. That covers collection, validation and storage, though only through marketing copy and brief API notes. Missing for 10: any evidence of expiry tracking or renewal alerts, explicit documentation that certificates are applied automatically during tax calculation, in-depth docs on how validation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
